---
title: Verify an update in your own script
description: Use a signed price directly, without a feed cell.
---

Instead of reading a feed cell, your script can verify the update blob itself. It suits settlement
at an exact time and designs where many transactions need prices in parallel.

```rust
use lean_oracle_common::price_update::verify_price_update;
use lean_oracle_common::publisher_set::PublisherSetData;

// The committee cell as a cell dep, found by its type hash.
let set = PublisherSetData::from_bytes(&committee_cell_data).ok_or(E)?;
// The blob from your witness.
let verified = verify_price_update(&blob, &feed_id, &committee_type_hash, &set).map_err(|_| E)?;

let price = verified.message.price;
let time = verified.header.publish_time_ms;
```

- **Cost.** About 8 million cycles per signature, versus 38,000 to read a feed cell.
- **Replay.** Nothing stops the same update being used twice or an older one being chosen. Your
  script must decide what is acceptable, for example `publish_time_ms == T` for settlement, or
  newer than a time it stores.
- **Current set only.** The committee cell dep holds the current keys; after a rotation, older
  updates no longer verify.
